articleTitle: Applying the CG-logistic Regression Method to Predict the Customer Churn Problem
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The aim of this paper is to study a new prediction method for the churn problem for airlines. For this end, a conjugate gradient logistic regression (CG-logistic regression) model is built, which integrates a conjugate gradient method with a logistic regression model. First, we classify churn and non-churn customers utilize the logistic regression model to, and then the conjugate gradient iterative method is applied as the optimum solution using the logistic regression model. At last, we present the outcomes of a simulative assessment and prove that the presented method is conducive to analyzing the churn problem for airlines.

articleTitle: Recycling Modes of Power Batteries of New Energy Vehicles Based on Principal Behavior
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: At present, the development of the new energy vehicles industry in China is still in its infancy. With the rapid growth of new energy vehicles, large number of used power batteries will emerge. Thus, how to manage battery recycling activities in the different stages of the new energy vehicles industry development, establishing efficient and reasonable modes of used power battery recycling, will become the major concerns of the new energy vehicles industry. To solve these problems, this paper investigates the principal behavior of government, producers and consumers when reusing power battery are reclaimed by distribution center, analyzes motivations of the participants in the recycling network, sets up the game model and summarizes the driving factors of their participation in recovering process, and finally, gives the countermeasures for the construction of China's power battery recycling network.

articleTitle: The Influence of Corporate Reputation on Consumer Brand Loyalty in Caused-Related Marketing
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: "Buy a bottle of water and donate a penny" is a marketing campaign by Nongfu Spring. We collectively refer to similar activities as cause-related marketing (CRM). First of all, through the research of previous scholars, a new research model on brand loyalty is established. For further research, the first step is to verify the relationship between emotional reputation, cognitive reputation and consumer trust and brand loyalty. What is more important is to examine the intermediary role of consumer trust. This paper mainly examines how corporate reputation influences consumer brand loyalty. The application of Wen's intermediary effect test model mediates the mediating role of consumer trust. The results reveal a positive mediating effect of consumer trust between emotional reputation and brand loyalty. However, when testing the cognition reputation, the result is negative.

articleTitle: An Analysis of R&D Competence and Development Trend of China’s New Energy Vehicle Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The R&D efficiency of new energy vehicle companies has drawn great attention of researchers. This paper investigates the R&D efficiency of China's new energy vehicle companies. We collected R&D data from 20 China's new energy auto firms in the year of 2015 and 2016, the sales of these companies are ranked in the top 20 in China. The sample firms cover almost all of powerful state-owned and private new energy auto makers. Furthermore, we established a framework for assessing the technical innovation efficiency, which includes 5 types of variables as input indicator: H&R inputs, R&D investment, R&D environment, technical inputs and enterprise scale; 3 types of variables as output indicators: economic output, technical output and competitive output. Through using data envelopment analysis, we conducted empirical assessment of technical innovation efficiency, pure technical innovation and scale efficiency for China's major car producers in the year of 2015 and 2016. The results show that most of China's new energy vehicle companies are technical inefficient and generally state-owned enterprises are relatively more efficient than private companies. At last, we proposed some suggestions and advices on how to improve technical innovation efficiency for China's auto makers.

articleTitle: Total Factor Productivity Change of Traditional Manufacturing Industry of Beijing
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Traditional manufacturing industry is closely related to industrial development and people's lives. In this paper, input and output panel data of traditional manufacturing industry of Beijing in the period of 2000-2014 are selected as the research object. DEA-Malmquist index method is used to study the change of total factor productivity and decomposition efficiency. The results show that the growth of total factor productivity of traditional manufacturing industry of Beijing mainly relied on technological progress, and that technological efficiency declined during the sample period. Pure technological efficiency was less than 1 throughout the sample period, while scale efficiency gradually increased. The overall input-output level deviated from the optimal production status. Among 18 subdivision industries, only three subdivision industries achieved improvement in total factor productivity.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Resource Tax Burden on Regional Economy and Industrial Structure
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper constructs a dynamic general equilibrium model of resource tax, exhaustible resource allocation and economic growth based on the exhaustion and scarcity of exhaustible resources, as well as the characteristics of negative externalities, and simulates the impact of resource tax burden on regional economic development and industrial structure. The study finds that according to the economic development level and industrial structure pattern of different regions, setting up differential resource tax burden can effectively control the supply and demand of exhaustible resources, and make a positive role in industrial structure adjustment.

articleTitle: Algorithm in E-commerce Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: It is a very significant issue for the e-commerce industry to recommend the high quality goods for the users in the mass information. However, the accuracy and efficiency have seriously affected the recommendation quality of the recommendation system. In order to solve this problem effectively, this paper first uses support vector machines (SVM) to classify products, obtaining the positive and negative feedbacks of each product. Then it calculates the comprehensive scores of product ratings and reviews for positive feedback; the comprehensive scoring data is used to establish a collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm, and a final recommendation list is generated according to the preference score. Finally, Taobao's online data is used to verify the proposed algorithm. The research results show that the algorithm has good recommendation accuracy and speed, and has a certain practical value.

articleTitle: Strategic Manipulation in Multiple Attribute Decision Making with Interval Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Strategic manipulation or non-cooperative behavior means that decision makers will make dishonest decisions or changes their decision according to their own interests. In this paper, strategic manipulation is applied to multiple attribute decision making (MADM), in which decision makers can manipulate ranking results through attribute weights. In view of uncertainty evaluations in decision making, the alternative evaluations are assumed to be represented in interval values, and a final decision result can be obtained by aggregating the interval evaluations of alternatives under different attribute weights. Firstly, a model is established to estimate the ranking of all alternatives, and a strategic manipulation model is further established to obtain the desired ranking by manipulating attribute weights. The proposed method can better conform to the actual situation by considering the uncertainty. Finally, the method is applied to the university ranking to obtain the desired ranking results and help decision makers choose the attribute weights according to their desired ranking of universities. Numerical simulation also verifies the effectiveness and rationality of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Does the High-speed Railway Reduce the Urban-rural Income Gap?
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The opening of high-speed railway has a positive effect on the economic growth. While whether the effect can be shared by everyone equally is unknown. Especially, the research about the impact of high-speed railway on the urban and rural income distribution is still insufficient. This paper uses the spatial econometric model to test the influence of high-speed railway on urban-rural income gap through provincial panel data between 2004 and 2015 in China. It is found that, high-speed railway can narrow the income gap between urban and rural areas. And further analysis shows that high-speed railway can not only significantly improve the urban residents' income, but also can improve the income of rural residents, which is a Pareto improvement, and it can reduce the income gap between urban and rural areas as a whole.

articleTitle: Social and Economic Factors' Impact on Fire Safety Risks-Panel Data Model Based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: A panel data model, with analyzing selected social-economic factors, is presented to reveal the relationship between China's social-economic development and the number of fire occurrences. Considering the changes of statistical calibers in different years, a few dummy variables are added to improve the model's goodness of fit. The results show that the level of economic development and education level are significantly correlated with the number of fire occurrences. The conclusions of this study will help to provide policy advice on China's fire prevention work during the period of social transformation.

articleTitle: The "Internet+ Property" Enterprise Competitiveness Model Based on Value Chain Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper constructs the competitiveness evaluation model of "Internet+ property" service enterprises systematically using the method of value chain analysis. Based on the 2016 public information of 16 major property service companies, the competitiveness evaluation system was verified. The research results show that the competitiveness model of real estate service companies constructed in this paper and its evaluation results are basically consistent with the actual business performance of the company. It is an effective method to evaluate the competitiveness of real estate service companies in the context of "Internet+".

articleTitle: User Satisfaction Management in E-Government: One K-means Algorithm-based Analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Although big progress has been made in e-government of China, there are still numerous problems to be resolved, such as excessive consumption of resources, low user satisfaction and Information Island. The research one-government of user satisfaction development path will effectively promote the substantial development of e-government in China. Firstly, this paper puts forward the ecological development system of e-government, including system user and subject-object model of platform system. At the same time, the K-means algorithm is used to construct the user segmentation model of e-government and the AISAS method is used to establish the short-term evaluation model of e-government affairs openness. The feedback provided by the evaluation model effectively improved the user service level.

articleTitle: The Willingness to Use the Campus Express Delivery Service Based on UTAUT
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The college students' delivery service is a new business model to solve the last kilometer logistics on campus. In this paper, we study the willingness to use the campus express delivery service based on the Unified Theory of Acceptance and Use of Technology (UTAUT). The results show that: Performance Expectancy and Social Influence have a positive impact on the delivery business, further more, the Effort Expectancy has a negative impact on the delivery business. According to these results, we make some suggestions for the better development of the campus express delivery service.

articleTitle: The Cost Efficiency on Listed Chinese Water Company Based on SFA Model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper evaluates cost efficiency on listed Chinese water firms from 2010 to 2015 by using the stochastic frontier production analysis. Their accounting data is selected as sample. The finding suggests that the cost efficiency on Chinese water industry is improved from 0.5581 to 0.5790 due to the reform of property rights. Besides, there is still a 35% cost inefficiency among the sample enterprises. Since inefficiency exists, there is an opportunity to improve cost efficiency on Chinese water utilities. In addition, the empirical results explicate that the debt asset ratio, independent director size and per capita GDP will significantly and positively affect cost efficiency. The ratio of state owned assets and market concentration are negatively correlated with cost efficiency.

articleTitle: Risk Pricing and Consumers’ Equilibrium Strategies in A Quality-Based Make-to-Order/Service System
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper is concentrated on the service provider's optimal risky decision making problems in a quality-based make-to-order/service system. Different from a traditional operational management, consumers in our model have their own willingness to wait or leave when procuring service. We derive the risking pricing strategies under the interactions between service quality and consumers' intensity. Making the quality and service speed trade-off, the optimal pricing strategies and optimal service rate are obtained for the monopoly provider and the social planner respectively. We also find how the service provider's risk coefficient affect its optimal strategies as well as the consumers' equilibrium strategies through numerical examples.

articleTitle: The Influence of Executive Equity Incentive on Company Cash Holding
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Cash holding of the company has important influence on the decision. In addition, the operating efficiency of enterprises will also be affected by the level of cash holdings. The level of cash holding is too low, enterprises will be difficult to grasp the good external investment opportunities, but also make the financing constraints occur in time to raise enough funds; Based on agency theory, this paper expounds the mechanism of the influence of the senior executive equity incentive plan and its contract characteristics on the cash-holding level. Empirical results show that: Equity incentive plan can reduce the company's cash holdings, the low investment opportunities of the company's cash reduction role more prominent. This paper reveals the effect on the cash holding in different situations, and combs the characteristics of the equity incentive contract, which provides a reference for the design of the company's cash management and executive equity incentive contract.

articleTitle: The Analysis of Urban and Rural’s Relationship between the Financial Development and Social Welfare
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper did a research on the impact of financial development on social welfare based on the China panel data in 10 years. The paper found that when the level of financial development was high, the level of social welfare will be high too. But the paper also found that the unbalanced development will cause a bigger gap between urban and rural.

articleTitle: Ownership Structure, Industry Protection and Corporate Value
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The influence factors of corporate value have always been one of the debate focus in the academia. This paper empirically studies the influence of equity structure and industry protection on the value of the company through a regression analysis method with the data of listed companies in China's A-share market from 2014 to 2017. At the same time, we study the relationship between the interaction effect of equity structure, industry protection and the value of listed companies. The results indicate the more concentrated the ownership structure, the more difficult it is to reach the value of the enterprise in the capital market of China. At present, the existence of industry protection fails to promote the value of the enterprise. On the contrary, the value of the listed company in the unprotected industry is easier to increase. Compared with the listed companies which are protected, the unprotected companies shows more significant negative correlation between ownership structure and corporate value, as the ownership structure tends to be concentrated.

articleTitle: Do Chinese HSR Promote Economy?
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the formation of the Four Vertical and Four Horizontal high speed railway (HSR) network in China, HSR has significantly improved Chinese regional accessibility. This paper evaluates the effect of HSRs on the economic growth in China using the data from 2007 to 2016 and uses the Gradient Boosting Regression Tree to carry out an empirical test. The paper argues that when analyzing the economic impact of new transportation means, both the construction of itself and improvement of transportation conditions should be taken into account. Therefore, the HSR was studied by operation mileages and its proportion to total railway mileage. The main conclusion from the paper is that Chinese HSR has a positive effect on economic growth. The difference of the purpose and background of HSR construction between China and other countries may be the reasons for the inconsistency of the research conclusions. Thus, Chinese government needs to optimize the HSR networks and improve transport services.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Quality Competitiveness of Kiwi Fruit Industry Based on Supply Chain
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Quality has a critical impact on a firm’s competitiveness. This paper builds a quality competitiveness evaluation model for the Chinese kiwi fruit industry based on Porter’s diamond model and the supply chain model. The elements of the model are factor conditions, planting production, process control and logistics, customer value, leadership and supervision, as well as sustainable development. The quality competitiveness of the kiwi fruit industry is obtained by analytic hierarchy process and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation. Suggestions to enhance the quality competitiveness of the Chinese kiwi fruit industry are also given.

articleTitle: Human Capital and Economic Growth: Evidence from Macau Gaming Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The study aims to investigate the relationship between human capital in Macau gaming industry and economic growth over the period from the third quarter of 2001 to the third quarter of 2017. The findings of the study show that there exists a long-run co-integration relationship among GDP, education attainment at all levels, average schooling years, education Gini coefficient and total wages of employees. Average schooling years have negative effect on economic growth, whilst other variables have positive effect on economic growth. The study concludes that human capital of casino industry acts as a key determinant of economic growth in Macau. In recent years, violent competitions have emerged from Asian countries, and they have continuously provided new electronic gaming products. It is acceptable that employees with higher education attainment have abilities to learn new skills and knowledge and then create new products. We would suggest that the government has to pay more attention to investment in human capital to maintain sustainable economic growth.

articleTitle: Is the Cultural Industry Reasonable in Beijing? – An Empirical Analysis from the Cultural Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Culture is an important spiritual foundation for nation, and cultural industry is an important industry in China's national economy. In recent years, the cultural industry in Beijing has developed rapidly. In 2016, the added value of Beijing's cultural industry increased by 358 billion 110 million yuan, the city's cultural industrial units have reached 8033. In this paper, It is used the Shift-Share Analysis method to analyze the culture structural and departmental competitiveness of the cultural industry in Beijing. From the 3 economic growth factors: Structural Component, Competitive Component, and Total Deviation Component, we put forward the future direction and emphasis of the development of cultural industry in Beijing.

articleTitle: Ownership Concentration, Free Cash Flow and Over-investment
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper studied the over-investment caused by free cash flow from the perspective of ownership concentration. The study found that the existence of significant positive correlation between over-investment and free cash flow which confirms the free cash flow hypothesis. Ownership concentration is negatively correlated with excessive free cash flow of the company. Ownership concentration can effectively inhibit excessive investment caused by free cash flow. The above study not only provides empirical evidence for the explanation of over-investment caused by agency problems, but also provides a useful reference for the ownership concentration of listed companies which is most conducive to improving corporate governance after the completion of the ownership division reform.

articleTitle: Evaluation Model of Project Management Maturity for Highway Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In order to enhance the ability of project management and market competitiveness for highway enterprises, big data model were studied based on the theory of project management. Through importance analysis of index, highway enterprise project management big data model was established. Then, fuzzy comprehensive evaluating method was used for the evaluation of highway enterprise project management big data model. Finally, through case study, the big data of the project management was evaluated for the highway enterprise in Hebei province. The experimental results show that highway enterprises generally have a strong sense of quality management. However, there is a universal phenomenon that most of the product lack of innovation. Based on the above research, this paper puts forward some constructive suggestions for the project management of highway enterprises.

articleTitle: Regional Economic Development and Transportation Resources Allocation in China
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In this paper, 2015 cross-sectional data of 31 provinces and cities in China are used to verify the coordinated relationship between transportation resource allocation and regional economic development. This paper establishes an evaluation index system and model for regional economic development and allocation of transportation resources. The comprehensive level of regional economic development and regional transportation resource allocation were evaluated and ranked respectively by the principal component analysis and entropy method. Then, the Euclidean distances are calculated for each of the two systems in each region to examine the coordination of economic development and allocation of transportation resources. Based on the scoring of the two systems, the linear equations are fitted with the allocation of regional transportation resources and the level of regional economic development as independent variables to quantify the degree of influence between the two systems. The empirical results show that there is a close relationship between the allocation of regional transportation resources and economic development, and the two have a certain degree of coordination. However, there are significant differences in the degree of coordination between different regions. In view of the uncoordinated traffic resources allocation and regional economic development, this paper also put forward corresponding countermeasures and suggestions.

articleTitle: Analysis of China Real Estate Price Regulation Based on Game Theory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: By employing the game theory, we build three tripartite parties models, and take central government, local governments, real estate developers, banks, buyers and other elements into account to analyze the high real estate prices of China. We find that for the rational economic man pursues the maximization of his own interests, they secretly unite or construct more high-grade houses. And because of various reasons, China's real estate market has three major features, that is high land prices, high house prices, and high vacancy rates. The excessively high price-income ratio impairs the long-term interests of the central government and ultimately leads to the loss of low-income people's interests. We also put forward some suggestions in this paper.

articleTitle: Specialization and Regional Spacial Integration: A Case Study of Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of urbanization, the emergence functional specialization of urban cities has come to the attention of researches, which becomes an impetus to spacial integration of that region. This paper measures the specialization of sixteen core cities in Yangtze River Delta urban agglomerations with spatial division of function index and finds out that specialization is at a relatively low level and presents a continued momentum of decline in fluctuations. Based on the empirical analysis, this paper studies the internal mechanism of the specialization of urban agglomeration and regional spatial integration. And only by establishing a cooperative and complementary regional economic relationship between regional spatial diversification and urban spatial specialization could achieve regional integration.

articleTitle: The Impact of FDI on Haze Pollution—Based on the Local Government’s Introduction of FDI
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper uses the provincial data of PM2.5, FDI, population and science and technology input from 31 provinces (excluding Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan) from 2013 to 2016 to establish the panel data. Based on the STIRPAT (Stochastic Impacts by Regression on Population, Affluence and Technology) model and Cobb-Douglas production function, this paper uses the Generalized Method of Moments model to conduct a regression analysis of China's haze pollution. The results show that FDI (foreign direct investment) will have a "pollution halo" effect. Moreover, the introduction of more excellent FDI and increased investment in science and technology can improve the status of haze pollution in China. The population has a significant negative effect on PM2.5 concentrations. Therefore, based on the above analysis and conclusions, this paper proposes corresponding suggestions to contribute to the improvement of the status of haze pollution in China.

articleTitle: The Efficiency of Local Governments’ Fiscal Expenditure Based on the Study of the Value of Public Goods
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper builds a model based on the value of public goods, empirically analyzing China's eastern, central and western provincial differences in the efficiency of fiscal expenditure as well as the reaction to the macroeconomic environment. In our point of view, China's finance, especially local governments' finance, should focus on limited expenditure to pursue the maximum of effect. In the implementation of the Supply-Side Structural Reform, the governments of all kinds need to realize the optimization of fiscal expenditure structure.

articleTitle: Evaluation on the Coupling Effect of Traffic Resource Scale and Urban Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: As a basic industry of national economy, transportation has a long-term and comprehensive impact on urban economic development to varying degrees. At the same time, the development of urban economy also affects the level of traffic resources. Based on the concept of coupling, this paper constructs the coupling model of traffic resources scale and urban economic development around the two subsystems of traffic resource scale and urban economic development, and takes Beijing as an example to realize the quantitative measurement of the coupling between traffic resource scale and urban economic development. The results show that under the active traffic development policy of Beijing in recent years, the degree of mutual influence and coordination of Beijing's economic development and transportation resources scale has increased year by year, and it continues to rise.

articleTitle: The Application of Wavelet Analysis in Financial Multiple Change Points Time Series
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: In the dynamic financial market, the change of financial asset prices is always described as a certain random events which result in abrupt changes. The random time when the event occurs is called a change point. As the event happens, in order to mitigate property damage the government should increase the macro-control ability. As a result, we need to find a valid statistical model for change point problem to solve it effectively. Wavelet transformation method is introduced into financial market due to its convenience and simplicity. This paper proposes two methodologies which are Quandt-Andrews and wavelet transformation are to test the multiple change points stationary financial model in time series. We obtain the estimation of multiple change points, and compare the power of the two methods. From the real data analysis, the wavelet transformation method test is more efficient than Quandt-Andrews test.

articleTitle: Board Characteristics and Firm Performance: Evidence from 65 Media Listed Companies in China
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper selects 65 media listed companies as the research object, using SPSS to analyze the effect of board characteristics on firm performance. The characteristics are as follows: the number of committees, the proportion of independent directors with relevant background, the number of board meetings, the size of the board, the proportion of female directors and the structure of leadership. Specific conclusions are as follows: the number of committees has a positive impact on firm performance; the proportion of independent directors with relevant background has a positive impact on the firm performance; finally, the number of board meetings are uncorrelated with firm performance, as well as the size of the board of directors, the proportion of female directors and the structure of leadership.

articleTitle: Fuzzy DEA Based on Team Reasoning for the Efficiency Evaluation of A Logistics Enterprise
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper proposes an improved method of data envelopment analysis (DEA) for the efficiency evaluation considering the thinking of team reasoning and the fuzzy information. On the one hand, team reasoning is introduced to reflect that the overall efficiency of the team is more important than that of the individual decision making units (DMUs). On the other hand, in real decision making process, not all the evaluations can be expressed by using precise information, fuzzy information may be more suitable to be used. The interval numbers are used to character the evaluations of inputs and outputs of DMUs, and then models are established to calculate the overall efficiency of the team. The interval efficiency of each DMU is further calculated with the condition that the overall efficiency of the team is satisfied. The method is finally applied in the efficiency evaluation of a logistics enterprise.

articleTitle: Influence of Accessibility of Cities along the Shi-Wu High Speed Rail Based on Generalized Weighted Travel Time
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This study aims at analyzing the accessibility change of cities along Shi-Wu high-speed rail (HSR) line. We made an empirical study on the influence of Shi-Wu high-speed rail on the urban accessibility change along the way through weighting average travel time method and the generalized weighing travel time method. The two scenarios are set as with and without the advent of Shi-Wu HSR. Then we make a serious comparison about accessibility between these scenarios. It is found that if we consider travel time as the only factor, the accessibility of cities with HSR stations will be improved significantly. However, if the high price of the construction and operation of HSR is taken account in, there will be only slight improvement in accessibility.

articleTitle: Development Status of Ecological Transportation System and Its Impact on Industrial Layout
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: As the context of the city, traffic construction plays an important role in economic development. But with the rapid development of urbanization, the traditional transportation system has become more and more difficult to meet the needs of economic development. Under this, the ecological transportation system emerges as the times require. In this paper, the ecological traffic comprehensive index of various provinces and cities is obtained through the construction of the ecological traffic evaluation system and the method of factor and cluster analysis. So the purpose of this article is to study the problems existing in the development of ecological transportation system, put forward corresponding policy recommendations, and explore its impact on industrial layout.

articleTitle: The Order Prediction of A Catering O2O Enterprise Based on the Combined ARIMA-BP Model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the continuous pursuit of the quality of life and the arrival of the "Internet+" era, more and more enterprises are using O2O, a combination of online and offline operations to meet the needs of users. As an important vertical classification in the O2O field, catering enterprises usually cooperate with online and offline catering businesses to improve data operation capability by forecasting the trend of orders. On the basis of analyzing the O2O enterprise's existing business model and management of data, this paper establishes an ARIMA time series, a BP neural network model and a combined model to predict the order of the enterprise based on a takeaway operation data of a catering enterprise, and implements and verifies the model. Through the comparative analysis of the prediction results of the model, this paper can help enterprises carry out in-depth data operation in the catering O2O mode, and assist enterprises at all levels to make reasonable resource allocation.

articleTitle: The Effect of the Value of Travel Time Saving on the Passengers Choosing Different Types of Railway Trips
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the rapid development of China's high-speed railways in recent years, more and more residents travel between high-speed railways and ordinary railways. There are many factors that affect consumers' choice of modes of transportation and the value of saving travel time is decided important choice of consumer traffic behavior. Based on the value of saving travel time, this paper chooses 16 cities along the Jing-Guang Railroad and 120 "city pairs" as the research object to study the influence of the value of saving travel time on the choice of travel style of urban residents on this channel and to study the relevance between saving travel time value and travelers' choice of travel.

articleTitle: Safety Evaluation of Medication in Chinese Laying Hens Companies Based on Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper constructs a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation system to evaluate the safety of medication in Chinese laying hens companies. Five first-grade indicators and 23 second-grade indicators are determined based on the Delphi method. The weight of every indicator is also distributed by the Delphi method. An evaluation of a case company is carried out. The evaluation results classified 0%, 0%, 35.09%, 47.22% and 17.7% of medication practices of this case company as unsafe, moderately unsafe, slightly safe, moderately safe, and safe, respectively. The evaluation results are consistent with the case company's medication practices. Finally, this paper proposes several suggestions to improve the medication management practices of laying hens companies in China.

articleTitle: Teacher Resource Network Evaluation System Research Based on Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Given the background that the Sino foreign cooperative education project is increasing, this research is devoted to the construction of a teachers' resources network. Through interviews and questionnaires, we collected teachers' evaluation indexes and made a further investigation, and then constructed a teachers' resources network evaluation system based on competency model. This evaluation system will combine Chinese teachers, foreign teachers, and enterprise mentors together and build the teachers' resources network, which can select the suitable teachers from the network and make the teacher system of the Sino foreign cooperative education more reasonable and diversified.

articleTitle: Science and Technology Service Industry Agglomeration and Regional Innovation: Does Human Capital Matter?
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: By improving the traditional knowledge production function, this paper establishes a theoretical link among the agglomeration of science and technology service industry, human capital and regional innovation. Based on the data from the year 1985 to 2016 in Beijing, this paper finds that after the introduction of industrial agglomeration, human capital and their interaction item, the adjusted knowledge production function has a better fit than the traditional one, and it can report a better quantitative relationship between regional innovation and its determinants; besides, the level of human capital will strongly adjust the relationship between the agglomeration of the industry and the innovation capability within the region, specifically, only when the level of human capital is higher than a certain threshold, will industrial agglomeration effectively enhance regional innovation.

articleTitle: The Impact of Shareholding Structure on Enterprise Performance under Different Types of Placards
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: From 2013 to 2017, the wave of insurance placards surged from an overwhelming tide to disappearance, but the influence of placards continued in the follow-up period. This paper studies the performance's changes of listed companies before and after the placards year and explores the correlation between ownership structure and firm performance. The result shows that the performance falls significantly in the takeover year, the relation between it and the first big shareholder's ratio is the inverted "U" type in insurance sample, while it is the "U" type in non-insurance sample. What's more, the manager shareholding ratio, the ownership concentration and equity separation all play different roles in the insurance and non-insurance sample. The above study not only reveals how to improve the companies' shareholding structure and avoid malicious acquisitions but also gives suggestions on how to deal with the subsequent influence brought by the placards in today's environment, revealing what factors contribute to the improvement of performance.

articleTitle: An Investigation on Equity Incentive under the "Personal Shares" Mode Based on Event Study Approach
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Equity incentive, evolving from the evolution of agency cost, property rights structure and corporate value theory, has become instrument in modern enterprise management. The current research of equity incentive is limited to motivating high-level professional managers, and there are very few corresponding studies on incentives for middle-level, low-level professional managers as well as grass roots. The equity incentive system under the "personal stock" mode is applicable to both high-level and low-level professional managers, even to core grass roots. Therefore, this paper analyzes the impact of equity incentive on performance and value of the corporation under the "personal shares" mode. The empirical results demonstrate that the "personal shares" equity incentive model can optimize the corporate structure, improve the labor efficiency of professional managers and grass roots, promote the company's capital accumulation, and attract and retain staffs.

articleTitle: Impact of Industrial Agglomeration on Total Factor Productivity of Cities: A Case Study of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Region
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Using the panel data of 13 cities in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei region for 2003-2016 years, this paper constructs a spatial measurement model based on three different spatial weights and studies the evolution of the spatial pattern of industrial agglomeration in this region, and the impact of industrial agglomeration on total factor productivity (TFP) of cities. The main conclusions are as follows: (1) The spatial pattern of manufacturing agglomeration spreads from the surrounding areas of Beijing to the southeast of Beijing and the central and southern regions of Hebei province; the spatial pattern of agglomeration of Productive Service Industry has gradually spread from the central and southern regions of Hebei and Beijing to the northern part of Hebei. (2) The estimation results based on the three spatial weighting matrices consistently show that manufacturing agglomeration has a significant negative impact on TFP in this region; On the contrary, Productive Service Industry have a significant positive impact on it. However, the degree of Co-agglomeration is significantly negative. (3) In the aspect of space spillover effect, there is a significant spatial correlation in the TFP, that is, the increase of urban economic efficiency in this region will affect the surrounding cities through spillover effect.

articleTitle: The Impact of High-Speed Railway on Labor Agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the development of economic and the improvement of urbanization, the labor mobility in China is becoming more and more widespread. Also, with the accumulation of labor mobility, there has been a feature that the labor force concentrated from the underdeveloped areas to the developed areas. The characteristics of high-speed railway (HSR) such as timeliness and regional accessibility can promote the process of urbanization, induce employment. Thereby it attracts labor mobility, and creates labor agglomeration. Based on the theory of "cyclic accumulation of causality", this paper establishes the mechanism of the impact of HSR on labor agglomeration. We conduct an empirical analysis of the three cities along the HSR of the Beijing-Guangzhou line, and analyze whether the Beijing-Guangzhou line has an impact on the labor agglomeration.

articleTitle: The Economic Growth Efficiency of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei Urban Agglomeration
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: At present, China has formed three world-class city agglomerations, they are the Yangtze River Delta, Pearl River Delta and Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei agglomeration. The integrated development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration has received more and more social attentions. Compared with other urban agglomerations, a characteristic of the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration shows that the difference of economic development is extremely large. Total factor productivity refers to the part of output increase which can't be explained by input factors. From domestic and foreign literatures, total factor productivity can be used to measure the quality of economic growth. Based on malmquist index, the change of total factor productivity growth can be decomposed into the change of technological progress, scale effect change and pure technical efficiency change. Therefore, in order to understand the regional difference of economic growth quality, the article makes an empirical study based on the data of 10 cities in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration, the time span is from 2000 to 2017. The result shows that there exists a serious regional imbalance of the total factor productivity in the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei urban agglomeration. In addition, the empirical results also suggest that the difference of total factor productivity mainly comes from the difference of technological progress. At last, according to the empirical results, in order to promote the regional economic integration, this paper puts forward a series of suggestions, such as developing comparative industries, promoting traffic integration, breaking the barriers of elements and so on.

articleTitle: The Impact of Information Technology on the Transformation and Upgrading of Chemical Industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Through in-depth analysis of the internal mechanism of the information technology to promote the transformation and upgrading of the chemical industry, this study found that: every 1% increases in information technology, the chemical industry will rise more than 0.59%. This leading role of information technology mainly promotes the innovation efficiency of production process, the efficiency of product development, marketing efficiency and management efficiency of chemical industry, and makes it break through the limitations of traditional development mode in production, R&D, management and market and finally realize the "innovative development". Therefore, accelerating the in-depth integration of information technology and chemical industry is the key way for the transformation and upgrading of China's chemical industry.

articleTitle: Nexus between Industrial Growth, Energy Consumption and Environmental Deterioration: OBOR Challenges and Prospects to China
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The introduction of One Belt One Road Initiative (OBOR) projects intensively triggered the industrial revolt in China which can greatly degrade its environment by carbon emission in the impending time. This study empirically assesses the long run and short run ties of such industrial revolution with CO2 emission and energy demand from 1971 to 2016. The study reliable its outcomes by applying diagnostics unit root, serial correlation, autocorrelation and normality tests. By applying ARDL bound test, the study reveals the positive and significant long-run linkages between industrial growth, services sector of the economy and energy consumption with CO2 emission, however economic development negatively impacted the emissions in the China. Granger causality reveals the unidirectional causation of energy consumption, industrial progression, and economic growth to CO2 emission correspondingly. It is intimated that the Chinese rulers need to address industrial waste to avoid environmental degradation, harmful pollutant stuff caused by CO2 emission. This step will guarantee Chinese sustainable growth in the long run and will produce a very effective outcome from OBOR project. Furthermore, the policy implication available for China as well as OBOR nations, to cater the environmental issues by making strict policies for industries and focus on renewable energy sources that help to lack the CO2 emission.

articleTitle: Dynamic Growth of Technological Innovation Capability of Manufacturing Enterprises from the Perspective of Open Innovation on Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The world's current economic development presents the only "unchanged" is "continuous change". This "continuous change" is the "innovation" that the academic community is increasingly concerned about. The development mode of the company is toward continuous cross-border, continuous innovation and development, and constantly breaking the original game rules and competitive landscape. However, if manufacturing companies want to successfully achieve "cross-border", knowledge search is considered to be a key factor in achieving "cross-border technological innovation". Knowledge search itself has "duality". How does the "duality" of knowledge search affect the improvement of technological innovation? Does absorptive capacity have an effect on external knowledge search and manufacturing companies' technological innovation capabilities? Due to the different theoretical perspectives, there is no definitive discussion on the growth model of the technological innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises in the academic circles. Based on the open innovation theory as the theoretical basis, what is the growth model for the technological innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises? This paper uses empirical analysis methods, latent variable mixed growth model and other methods to empirically analyze 305 manufacturing companies. The study finds that there are two different dynamic growth models for the technological innovation capability of manufacturing enterprises based on the open innovation theory: the growth model and the "U" growth model. Furthermore, it further examines how the duality of knowledge search, the breadth and depth of knowledge search, and absorptive capacity affect the two different technological innovation capacity growth models of manufacturing companies.

articleTitle: Urban Rail Transit and Economic Growth —An Empirical Analysis Based on China’s Cities Panel Data
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: China's urban rail transit has entered a stage of rapid development, and urban rail transit investment has also grown rapidly. This paper builds a model of urban rail transit on economic growth based on the consideration of the impact of various factors on the economic growth, using data of prefecture-level panel cities in China during 2003-2013. The empirical results of this paper indicate that the elasticity of urban rail transit on urban economic growth is 0.025, indicating that it plays an important role in the economic growth of China's cities and China's urban rail transit is a major city economic. The promotion effect of growth is very significant but has no significant effect on the economic growth of small cities. Buses, taxis, and road infrastructure also have a significant influence on promoting urban economic growth, but they are all embodied in small cities. Therefore, cities need to choose suitable transportation modes according to their own economic development. Major cities should continue to develop rail transit, promote the PPP model in the development process, and increase the ratio of light rail to suburban railways.

articleTitle: The Influence and the Development Path of the Sharing Economy on the Economy of China from An Empirical Study
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The sharing economy is an emerging research field. The form of sharing economy that is emerged by using many information technologies such as the mobile Internet, the big data, the cloud computing, the block chain, etc. profoundly influences and changes the traditional economic form of human society with the emerging economic formats in the information age. Under the background of the new era, clarifying the basic connotation, performance characteristics and main functions of the sharing economy can attach a great significance on better promoting the high-quality development of the sharing economy and building a modern economic system. It is believed in this article that the connotation of the sharing economy can be grasped from the scope of development, motivation, ideas and models. The sharing economy has the characteristics of rapid development, diversified subjects, clear operating mechanism and differences in economic composition. We then derive 9 variables with almost equal importance which reflect the development of sharing economy through Factor Analysis. The development of sharing economy has entered a new era. While promoting the development of shared economy, we should promote the deep integration of new and old formats, foster the sharing of information and cultural genes, build a pragmatic and invasive system, apply an inclusive and prudent regulatory system, and create a social environment of joint construction and sharing. This article helps to deepen the understanding of the sharing economy and has certain reference value for theoretical research and practical development in this field.

articleTitle: Effects of Odd-Even Traffic Restriction on Traffic Congestion and Air Quality
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The paper is to argue whether the "odd-even" traffic restriction policy in Beijing is an effective and efficient way to alleviate urban traffic congestion and lower emission of pollutant, by reviewing the traffic restriction in Beijing between 2014 to 2015, using hypotheses based on academic researches and peer reviews, interpreting the data and statistics, and finally to generate the conclusion. It is found that the policy may ease traffic congestion but will deliver very limited result to solve the air pollution problems in the long run. The paper lays foundation for the formulation of future urban traffic restriction policy.

articleTitle: The Impact of Environmental Regulations on Private Investment Efficiency
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This article using the mediation test model, studies the influence the environment regulation, which has on investment efficiency directly. Based on the private listed companies during 2011 to 2015, investment opportunities and technical innovations are studied through two mediators. We find that environmental regulation improves the companies' investment efficiency. In particular, environmental regulation decreases companies' investment opportunities and improves technical innovations, which proves the "Porter Hypothesis".

articleTitle: Cluster of Financial Industry of Urban Agglomeration in China – A Panel Data Study
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: With the promotion of different new electronic payment methods via mobile phone, the development of China's financial industry is getting attention from international scholars in a new way. Interestingly, China's financial activities extend and capture the world while reflecting strong regional characteristics. How are these clusters of financial formed and what are the key elements? With regard to these central questions, this article explores the influence factors of Chinese financial agglomeration based on a 15-year data set. The findings present that the relative power of urban agglomeration is a considerable factor influencing financial agglomeration pace and scale.

articleTitle: Improvement of Container Logistics Efficiency in China through Legislative Innovations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Container is one of the most important movable transportation tools for the development of modern logistics. However, there still exist a lot of problem about container technical norms, infrastructure standard, information criteria, and coordination with international container regulation, etc. Therefore, it's imperative to reduce modern logistical cost and improve logistical operation efficiency through the development and innovation of legislative innovations of double-stack container, semi-trailer, piggy-back transportation, companied and un-companied transportation. The author established an evolutionary game theory analysis framework and demonstrated that under stricter container legislation regulations, the container enterprises tend to adopt a unified container technical standard and operation rules which in turn, will increase logistics efficiency. The policy implication is that Chinese government should adopt a more up-down compulsory container standard and operation regulations which benefit the transportation and logistics industry as a whole.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Liquidity Black Hole Effect of A-share Market
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The leverage level, interbank rate, index futures and market sentiments are the factors that influence A-share market liquidity. Then the relationship among variables is studied by using vector autoregressive model, Granger causality test and impulse response function. The results show that the influence of each variable on liquidity is not sustained, but the trading volume has negative effect on liquidity. As a result, the "liquidity black hole" effect of A-shares was triggered during the market crash period. At this time, the rescue measures aimed at increasing trading volumes might not be effective.

articleTitle: Connectivity Reliabilitsy of Container Shipping Network of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: A container shipping network of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road is mainly composed of four heading networks: Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East-North Africa and Europe. In this paper, a connectivity reliability simulation model is set up when the ports along the route are under random attack by using the simulation method, and the reachable matrix is introduced to judge the variation of the connectivity reliability of the shipping network and the four heading networks. The container shipping network of the 21st Century Maritime Silk Road was relatively reliable. Among its four heading networks, the connectivity reliability of European heading was relatively poor, and that of Southeast Asia was relatively good. In addition, using qualitative and quantitative methods to judge the node importance and implement the key node protection strategy for re-simulation, it can be gotten that the key node protection strategy is effective to improve the connectivity reliability of the whole network and each heading network.

articleTitle: How the Economic Value Added Influences on the Over-investment Behavior of Enterprises – Based on the Data of A-share SOEs
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Enterprises investment behavior and efficiency are always the focus of academic attention, it is closely related with the performance evaluation methods of corporate management, good performance measures can influent and improve investment efficiency of enterprises. In recent years, investment brings tremendous pressure to the economic development, However, the macro data show that the investment efficiency of China's central enterprises is low and does not match the level of investment. SASAC formally added EVA indicator which is the measure of value creation capacity of enterprises, as the head of the state-owned enterprises core indicators of performance appraisal in 2010. This paper collects data of listed companies of A-share SOEs from 2008 to 2014, testing and counting the scale of over-investment according to Richardson investment model, examining the effectiveness of the EVA assessment system, and exploring whether it meets the SASAC's expectation of effectively investment, or what improvements it can make.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Relationship between Transportation Infrastructure and Regional Economic Development in Yunnan Province
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Yunnan is one of the provinces which play a key role in the construction of the "The Belt and Road" in China, thus, strengthening the level of its economic development will be conducive to the promotion of the construction of the international economic cooperation corridor. Based on the VAR model, this paper empirically analyzes the relationship between transportation infrastructure and economic growth in Yunnan Province from 1992 to 2015, namely roads, railways, and water transport. The results show that the transportation infrastructure and regional economic growth are linked to each other in Yunnan. Also, different types of transport infrastructure have mutual influences. Among them, the highways and waterways dominate. Yunnan should focus on building and improving the construction of transportation infrastructure to promote the coordinated development of regional economy.

articleTitle: Systematic Analysis and Evaluation of Internet Industry Security
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This paper systematically analyzes the four major factors affecting the Internet industry security and establishes a four-dimensional evaluation system of Internet industry security based on industrial openness, adaptability, dynamics and correlation. The entropy weight method is used to set weights. Taking Beijing as an example, the author conducts a quantitative analysis of Internet industry security from 2008 to 2015 and finds that the Internet industry security is mainly affected by lack of R&D investment for enterprises, insecure network environment and vigorous national support. This paper also proposes feasible measures for accelerating the formation of standard system for Internet data application, adjusting the structure of Internet industry, establishing an investment and financing system for Internet industry and improving the overall environment for Internet security of China.

articleTitle: Spatial Spillover Effects of Chinese Transport Infrastructure on Regional Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the methods of Exploratory Spatial Data Analysis, this paper proves that the spatial clustering trend and positive spatial autocorrelation on Chinese regional economic development are significant from 2003 to 2017. According to 31 provincial data in 2003, 2010 and 2017, we conduct an empirical study concerning the spatial spillover effects of transport infrastructure on regional economic growth. The result shows that the capital and labor still make the largest contributions to the regional economic growth. The human capital, government expenditure, trade openness and the transport infrastructure play a more and more important positive role in promoting the economic development. Moreover, the direct effects of transport infrastructure on regional economic growth still account for the vast majority of the whole effects. A positive spatial spillover effect significantly exists and without considering the spatial spillover effects will overestimate the direct effects of transport infrastructure on economic growth.

articleTitle: Urbanization Quality Evaluation and Strategy Research of Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: The report of the Nineteenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China emphasized that urban agglomeration should be taken as the main body to build a coordinated pattern among different types of cities. China should speed up the urbanization of agricultural population and promote the coordinated development of Beijing, Tianjin and Hebei by dredging the non-capitalist functions of Beijing. This requires optimizing urban space structure, improving the urban environment thus it will lighten the general pressure on the Beijing. New urbanization plays a significant role for Hebei province in promoting economic growth and narrowing the gap with Beijing and Tianjin. Under the current constraints of ecological environment and resource, what actions should Hebei Province take to improve the quality of new urbanization is a question worth discussing in depth. Hebei should strengthen the supporting function of science and technology, and always hold the idea that man is the first to improve rural area system planning by new modes of sustainable growth.

articleTitle: Scale Development of Family Safety Climate for Railway Drivers in China
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Safety behavior of railway drivers has great significance to the safe operation of trains and the safe travel of passengers. The family safety climate is a crucial factor in the conduct of safety behavior. However, most of the research on the current family safety climate focus on vehicle drivers other than railway drivers. This paper studies the structure and measurement of the railway driver's family safety climate. The results show that the railway driver's family safety climate includes three dimensions: safety communication, safety commitment and safety awareness and the measurement scale consists of 15 items. This study also lays the foundation for the further study of railway driver's family safety climate.

articleTitle: Application of Self-Liquidation Ratio in Urban Rail Transit PPP
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Financial self-liquidation ratio is a key criterion for measuring the performance of urban rail transit. Studying the change of the self-liquidation ratio under PPP mode has important guiding significance for the rational planning of the construction and operation of urban rail transit. This paper first discusses how to design the mechanism under the PPP mode to motivate various participants of the urban rail transit project to actively invest in the construction and operation of urban rail transit projects. Based on the existing self-liquidation ratio mode, it analyzes the rationality and accuracy of its composition from the theoretical perspective, considers the competitive neutrality and transferable risk-taking costs from the application level, and establishes a new self-liquidation ratio mode, which initiates inspiring thinking about the research on self-liquidation ratio mode. The new self-liquidation ratio mode can more accurately reflect the actual government performance under the non-PPP mode and has a strong incentive for attracting social capital into urban rail transit projects. Secondly, by comparing the financial indicators of the MTR Corporation and the metropolitan operation companies in Mainland China, we analyzed the revenue and cost to explore whether the PPP model can effectively enhance the financial benefits of urban rail transit. Finally, through a detailed analysis of the successful cases of the MTR Corporation, suggestions are made for the development of urban rail transit in China.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Leadership-member Exchange and Knowledge Sharing: From the Perspective of Social Relations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: Based on the perspective of social relations, this paper examined the predictive powers of leadership-member exchange on knowledge sharing, and the mediating role of workplace friendship between them. Furthermore, we also examined the moderating role of power distance between leadership-member exchange and workplace friendship. Questionnaire survey data were collected from 214 railway workers in China. In general, the results show that: (1) the leadership-member exchange has a significant positive impact on the knowledge sharing; (2) workplace friendship plays a partial mediating role between leadership-member exchange and knowledge sharing; (3) power distance plays moderating role between leadership-member exchange and workplace friendship. The higher the power distance perceived by employees, the weaker the positive relationship between the leadership-member exchange and the workplace friendship. Finally, theoretical and practical implications were put forwarded stemming from this study and the suggest directions for future researches were also provided.

articleTitle: How the Executive Compensation Effects the Performance of Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: This study investigates how the executive compensation effects the performance of companies. We select the relevant data from 2013 to 2015 of listed companies in China as a sample, and conduct empirical research on the samples. It is concluded that the performance levels of listed companies in China are different. We find that company performance is positively associated with executive currency remuneration and executive equity remuneration. Moreover, there are differences in executive currency compensation and stock incentives, and some listed companies face the problem of mismatch between executive compensation and company performance. The results will be useful to make a reasonable executive compensation policy when improving corporate performance.

articleTitle: The DEA Model of Industrial Restructuring and Dominant Industry for Resource-based Cities
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Industrial Economics System and Industrial Security Engineering (IEIS)
abstract: For a long time, resource-based cities in China have made a great contribution to the development of the national economy. However, due to the development path, the vast majority of Chinese resource-based cities have begun to be confronted with a series of problems. Meanwhile, the decline of leading industries in resource-based cities has brought about economic and social problems. In this situation, the study on how to implement industrial restructuring in resource-based cities becomes a very important issue, and it is also the content and purpose of this paper. Upon analyzing the basic situation of Hengyang City, this paper then mainly discussed the city's industrial restructuring. The paper proposes the principles and the best mathematically derived mode of industrial transformation of Hengyang City. Using DEA model, this paper made an analysis on the selection of alternative industries in the industrial transformation process and proposed the significance, suggestions as well as the support system of industrial transformation of it. According to specific problems under study, some questions worth further study in this area were also discussed.
